content: Kuhabhuka kwa Babeli
Paghajomwiki mambu ghanihagha nakumbweni mtumika jongi wa kunani kumahunde, akahelalaje kuhuma kunani kumahunde. Akabhi na uwezu ukolongwa na ndema ukamulakiwi na ung'anyi wake.

Bhela, akajamalili kwa sauti ngolongwa, akapwaghaje, “Uhawike! Uhawike Babeli muchi ghola ukolongwa! Sajenu ubhili matamu gha mashetani na matamu gha kila roho ihakau, matamu gha kila chijuni chihakau na chechihakaliya nakanope.

Maghambu bhandu bha mataifa ghokapi bhakunywiki divai jikali ja ukemi wake. Nabhombi bhakolongwa bha pundema bhahengiki ugoni nako. Na bhahemela na bhalombesa hindu bha pundema ghoni bhalipatili hindu yamaheli kwa makili gha ing'omu yake.”
Bhela, nakajowini kabheti sauti kuhuma kunani kumahunde, jakapwaghaje,

content.text: Kwa ndandi mahoku ghaki ghalundakini mbaka kunani kumahunde,
mundepa mala pabheli nakanopi kwa mambu ghala ghaakatendike.
Mu chikombi chaki cheakahangaghini, munhangaghanya divai jikali mala pabheli
Kwa ntundu moakalilumbalili na kuhenga mambu gha kulihekeha,
mumpekya mabhinilu na huzuni kulengana na bhenibhela.
nepani nga mbomba nenhweliwi na ndomi wangu,
Maghambu malapuliku anaghumpata kwa lichobha limu,
maghambu Bambo Chapanga Mweni Makili nde joantemwile.”

content: Bhakolongwa bha ndema bhabhahengiki ugone papamu naku, na kutama naku matamu gha kulihekeha habha anabhaombulizaje na kulela chikahi pabhalibhonaje lyohi la muchi ghoutinyika kwa moto hoghu.

Anabhajemaje cha kutali koni bhakajoghupa mabhinilu ghaki na kupwagha, “Anauchibhonaje! Anauchibhonaje Babeli, muchi ghola ukolongwa, muchi ghola ghoubhi na makile! Maghambu kwa lisaa limu pela utemulu waku uhikike!”
Bhandu bhabhalombesa na kuhemela bha ndema ghoni anabhalelaje na kuombuleza, kwa ndandi njeta mundu joahemela hindu yabhu kabhete.

Njeta mundu wa kuhemela zahabu, madini gha feza, maganga gha mbija yamaheli, lulu, ingobhu jihuhu na ingobhu ya langi ja zambalau, ingobhu ja kunyelambuka, na ingobhu jikeli, yombu ya kila nkongu ghounungi wichu, yombu ya manyelu gha ndembu, yombu ya mikongu ja mbija yamaheli, yombu ya shaba, yombu ya choma, na malumalu,

na mdalasini, na ndimbalilo, ubane, mitela jejilowakeka manemane, manungilu, divai, mahuta gha zeituni, uhembi unyahi na ingano, ng'ombi na mambelele, falasi na magali gha kuhutakika, na bhandu kulombeswa ngati bhatumwa.

Na bhandu bhabhalombesa na kuhemela bhakumpwaghile, “Hindu inyahi yokapi yeutokulyaje kubha anaibya yaku ibhokike, wamaheli wa hindu yaku na matamu ghaku gha kulinyambiha ikubhokike, wala ngauwezi kuipata kabhete ng'o!”
Bhabhalombesa na kuhemela bhabhakalipati hindu yamaheli kubhokana na muchi ghonihoghu, anabhajemaje cha kutali kwa ndandi ja choghoi cha mabhinilu. Anabhalelaje na kuombuleza,

bhakapwaghaje, “Anauchibhonaje! Anauchibhonaje, muchi aghoghu ukolongwa! Ghoukabhi uwatikwi ingobhu jihuhu, na ingobhu ya zambalau na jikeli, na kulipamba kwa hindu ya zahabu, na hindu ya maganga gha mbija yamaheli na lulu!

Mu lisaa limu pela wamaheli waku ukolongwa wa hindu yaku ubhohakike!” Na kila joalongo sitima na kila joajenda pandu pokapi kwa sitima, bhabhalombesa na kuhemela kwa indela ja sitima na bhokapi bhabhahenga lihengu mu bahali, bhakajemiki cha kutali,
bhakaleliki namaa, pabhakaliweni lyohi la kutinyika kwaki, koni bhakapwaghaje, “Ngachekulabhali kubha muchi ngati muchi aghoghu ukolongwa!”

Bhakalijitali luhombi mu mimutu jabhu, koni bhakalelaje na kulangiha kubhina mtima, bhakapwaghaje, “Anauchibhonaje! Anauchibhonaje, muchi ghola ukolongwa! Muchi ambau bhokapi bhabhabhi na sitima yeijenda mubahali bhakapatiki wamaheli wa hindu kubhokana na mali ghake! Na mu lisaa limu pela uhoiki kila chindu!”
Muhekalyaje kwa ndandi jaki, mwenga mwentama kunani kumahundi hoku! Nanamu bhahuhu, na mitumi, na bhalota bhaka Chapanga! Maghambu Chapanga antemwi kwa ndandi ja mambu ghaakuntendi mwehapa!

Bhela, mtumika jumu wa kunani kumahunde joabhi na makili akajukwi liganga, ngati liganga la kuyaghila, akalileki mubahali, koni akapwaghaje, “Anana nde Babeli, muchi ghola ukolongwa anauyonangikaje, wala ngawibhonikani kabheti ng'o.

Wala sauti ya bhabhajemba ilimba, na bhabhajemba filimbe na mbata ngaijowaneki kabhete mkati jaku ng'o! Wala fundi wa ntundu wokapi jola wa lihengu lokapi lela ngaibhonikani kabhete mkati jaku ng'o! Wala sauti ja liganga la kuyaghila ngalijowaneki kabhete mkati jaku ng'o!

Unang'anu wa taa ngawinang'ani kabhete mkati jaku, wala sauti ya akabambo ndowa na akamabhu ukwati ngajijowaneki kabhete mkati jaku. Bhalombesa bhaku na bhahemela bhaku bhakabhi bhandu bhakolongwa bha pundema, na kwa uhabhi waku ukabhakolwi bhandu bha mataifa ghokapi gha pundema!”
Muchi wa Babeli hoghu ukatemuliwi kwa ndandi mkati jaki ukabhonakini mwahi wa bhalota bhaka Chapanga, mwahi wa bhahuhu na bhandu bhokapi bhabhakomakiki pundema.
